run_db_setup: run the db_setup function to configure a MySQL CI database environment with SQL files and environment variables
parse_db_version: parse a MySQL or MariaDB version string into a DbSystemType enum value like mysql5, mysql8, or mariadb
compute_disabled_features: compute a dictionary of disabled server features based on the detected database system type
run_sql_file: run a SQL file by piping its contents into the mysql client as root user
get_server_version: get the current MySQL server version string by running SELECT VERSION() via the mysql client
